//: Copy to foreman/config.json (ignored by git). Keys starting with // are comments. Secrets do NOT go here: use AGENTCRAFT_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment.
// host: Bridge address. Only loopback or private network addresses are accepted.
// home: State directory: tasks, decisions, memory, worktrees, logs.
// backend: sim = scripted team, no API usage (for development). claude = real agents.
// tokenFile: Optional: read the bridge token from a file outside git instead of AGENTCRAFT_TOKEN.
// models: lead/architect use 'lead', workers use 'worker', summaries use 'light'.
// maxConcurrent: Workers running at the same time.
// budget: Hard caps in USD. When reached, agents pause and the admins are told in game.
// cast: Change names, colors, personalities, skins (skin.name = a player name) or who is on shift at start.
